summary: Verified socket 'Not authenticated' race + stale-token-after-reconnect fix on the LIVE preview frontend against the OLD VPS backend. Placed multiple trades, forced a socket reconnect with an invalid token, confirmed the client detects the ack error, calls /api/auth/refresh, re-emits 'auth' and recovers on the very next click once a valid token is available — no page refresh required. No infinite retry loop. Extra 'token' field in trade payload is silently ignored by the OLD VPS backend (verified with direct python-socketio client), so the frontend change is safe to ship before the VPS backend is redeployed.

minor.issue: OLD VPS backend still returns 'Not authenticated' when the sid is not bound and a token is passed in payload (expected — the new sio_hub.py has not been deployed to the VPS yet). New /app/backend/routes/sio_hub.py inline-auth code has been statically reviewed: it strips the 'token' key before PlaceTradeRequest(**...), calls the existing _authenticate_sid helper (same code path as background/handshake auth), scopes the sid→user_id binding to the current sid only, and is wrapped in try/except so it cannot throw. Safe to deploy.

integration_issues.issue: When a click fires within ~200ms of navigation the ws.connected flag is still false, so placeTrade shows 'Not connected to trading server' instead of queuing. Not the RCA bug (RCA is about a CONNECTED-but-unauthenticated socket), but worth queuing the emit for a short grace period.

integration_issues.flow: Stale-token click with no refresh cookie
integration_issues.issue: Two POST /api/auth/refresh calls are fired for a single click (one from the socket 'connect' handler's ensureAuthed, one from the trade/place ack retry). Both bounded, no loop, but could be deduped by sharing an in-flight ensureAuthed() promise.

rca of the issue: CONFIRMED. Old client froze the JWT at mount time and passed it in the socket handshake auth (auth: { token }). The server authenticates the sid in a background task, so (1) a very fast first click could race the auth binding, and (2) after any ws reconnect the frozen token — often expired due to the short access-token TTL — left the sid unauthenticated forever, making every subsequent trade/place ack 'Not authenticated' until the page was manually refreshed. Fix (frontend, verified LIVE): socket auth is now a callback that re-reads localStorage on every (re)connect; on 'connect' the client emits 'auth' explicitly and, if the ack is not ok, runs ensureAuthed() which POSTs /api/auth/refresh, saves the new token, re-emits 'auth' and — as a last resort — cycles the socket. trade/place transparently re-authenticates and retries ONCE on a 'Not authenticated' ack. The trade payload also carries the current token so a pending sio_hub.py deploy can bind the sid inline. Fix (backend, /app/backend/routes/sio_hub.py, pending VPS deploy): on_trade_place inline-authenticates from payload.token when the sid is not yet bound, and strips the 'token' key before PlaceTradeRequest validation. Reviewed as safe.
